semantics.observation: Static Telco snapshot; no verified dates or future observation window.
semantics.thresholds: Fixed reviewable scenario thresholds; never empirical population quantiles.
semantics.tenure_zero: Historical averages and accumulated-charge comparisons remain unknown (NA).
semantics.internet_absence: Internet-only counts and interactions retain NA; internet_applicable identifies structural absence.
semantics.monetary_proxies: Current-rate arithmetic scenarios only; not actual historic charges, future revenue, or CLV.
semantics.fit_boundary: Builder learns no statistics; downstream imputer and scaler fit inside training folds only.
